gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o2 -> i2: Series of tests for the Match Rating Approach algorithm. General naming nomenclature for the test is of the form: GeneralMetadataOnTheTestArea_ActualTestValues_
UPDATED o4 -> i36: sanity check
UPDATED o5 -> i37: whitespace
ADDED i3: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#removeAccents(String)}.
ADDED i4: Punctuation and symbols are left untouched.
ADDED i5: Empty input is returned unchanged.
ADDED i6: Case is preserved while accents are stripped.
ADDED i7: Spaces (including runs of spaces) are preserved.
ADDED i8: A string with no accents is returned unchanged.
ADDED i9: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#cleanName(String)}.
ADDED i10: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#encode(String)}.
ADDED i11: Trivial input (null, empty, single space, single letter) encodes to nothing.
ADDED i12: Pure punctuation cleans away to nothing.
ADDED i13: Only a leading vowel survives.
ADDED i14: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#getFirst3Last3(String)}.
ADDED i15: Longer than 6 characters: first three + last three.
ADDED i16: Six or fewer characters: returned unchanged.
ADDED i17: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#getMinRating(int)}.
ADDED i18: sum <= 4 -> 5
ADDED i19: 5 <= sum <= 7 -> 4
ADDED i20: 8 <= sum <= 11 -> 3
ADDED i21: sum >= 13 -> 1
ADDED i22: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#isVowel(String)}.
ADDED i23: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#leftToRightThenRightToLeftProcessing(String, String)}.
ADDED i24: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#removeDoubleConsonants(String)}.
ADDED i25: Double consonants collapse to a single one.
ADDED i26: Double vowels are not affected.
ADDED i27: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#removeVowels(String)}.
ADDED i28: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#isEncodeEquals(String, String)}.
ADDED i29: Pairs of names that the algorithm considers homophonous.
ADDED i30: Accents, symbols and spaces are cleaned before comparing.
ADDED i31: Identical names short-circuit to a match.
ADDED i32: Pairs of names that the algorithm does not consider homophonous.
ADDED i33: Disappointing: these ought to match phonetically, but the algorithm says no.
ADDED i34: Names too short or whose codes differ by 3+ in length never match.
ADDED i35: Trivial / empty / null inputs are rejected before any comparison.
